_readme: Portfolio entries. To add a project: put photos in assets/img/, add an entry below, set "published": true, run python3 build.py. Categories: bathrooms, plumbing, fixtures, interiors. Never add a project that Team ASAP did not do.

projects.title: Matte-black shower with body jets
projects.description: Matte-black shower controls, four wall-mounted body jets, a handheld shower and a recessed tile niche set into large-format white tile.

projects.title: Bronze shower fixtures on subway tile
projects.description: A large shower head on a wall arm, a handheld shower on a slide bar and a single-handle valve in a bronze finish, set against white subway tile.

projects.title: Black vanity with marble top
projects.description: A two-door black vanity with a marble top, an oval sink and a matte-black widespread faucet.

projects.title: Chrome valve and handheld shower
projects.description: Single-handle chrome valve trim, a handheld shower and a wall supply elbow on white tile with a green glass mosaic band.

projects.title: Shower valve rough-in
projects.description: A shower valve set in a fresh mortar bed, ready for tile. Work in progress.

projects.title: Kitchen range and dishwasher
projects.description: A stainless steel range and dishwasher fitted into an existing run of kitchen cabinets.

projects.title: Hardwood floors, living room
projects.description: A living room with finished hardwood floors, a fireplace and built-in shelving.

projects.title: Basement drain lines
projects.description: Drain and supply piping in a basement utility area.

projects.title: Gas piping and shut-off valve
projects.description: Black iron gas piping with a lever-handle shut-off valve.

projects.title: Toilet flange and seal work
